method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Equities: Nvidia stands out as broader tech mood cools – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists say the global equity rally lost momentum near record highs as technology shares weakened. The S&P 500 edged lower and the Nasdaq underperformed, with AMD and semiconductor stocks retreating after recent gains.
Equities.reason: Deutsche Bank frames a market-level narrative: the broad equity rally is losing momentum because tech (and semis) are cooling while AI leadership is concentrated in a few names (Nvidia). This suggests a rotation/dispersion theme that is negative for tech-heavy indices and overall risk-on momentum.

Equities.title: Asian tech stocks drop with SK Hynix plunging 10% after Wall Street AI names fall
Equities.summary: Despite heightened volatility analysts remain optimistic over the outlook of the tech sector, with J.P. Morgan saying the tech sell-off had not derailed the AI investment cycle.
Equities.reason: Regional tech selloff led by large semiconductor names (SK Hynix) signals contagion from US AI-related weakness into Asian tech. This reinforces a dominant negative narrative for global tech equities and heightens volatility/risk-off in equity markets.

Equities.title: Sandisk, Western Digital drag on chip stocks as lofty expectations eclipse strong earnings
Equities.reason: Even solid earnings failed to satisfy elevated investor expectations, producing downside in chip names. This speaks to a broader theme of valuation-sensitive profit-taking in semiconductors—a negative signal for the tech/AI trade.

Equities.title: S&P 500, Dow futures steady as MidEast deal in focus; chips stumble
Equities.reason: Market-level read: geopolitical optimism (MidEast deal) is providing underlying support to futures even as chips lag. Net effect is modestly positive for broad equities because macro tail-risk is easing, offsetting sectoral weakness.

Equities.title: Dow closes at record on Mideast optimism; SpaceX, AMD drag Nasdaq
Equities.reason: Broad-market signal: easing geopolitical tensions (Mideast) is lifting cyclical/blue‑chip indices (Dow record) despite tech underperformance. This supports a rotation narrative from concentrated AI/tech winners into more cyclical segments.

Equities.title: Hedge Funds Take Big Hit in July After Bruising AI Selloff
Equities.reason: Widespread hedge‑fund losses amplify the market impact of the AI-led selloff, indicating deleveraging and forced flows that can exacerbate downside in equities—a negative for risk appetite and liquidity.

Equities.title: Morning Bid: AI stocks learn to fly — but ain't got wings
Equities.reason: The piece frames the prevailing narrative that AI enthusiasm is becoming overstretched; sentiment correction in AI names is the dominant short-term drag on equities and weighs on investor confidence.

Equities.title: U.S. ready to return to ‘commitments,’ Iran says as Strait of Hormuz deal looms
Equities.summary: Iran denied it was in talks with Washington, despite claims by Trump to the contrary.
Equities.reason: Developments suggesting a possible de‑escalation in the Strait of Hormuz reduce geopolitical risk premia, supporting cyclical and broad-market equities. This is a positive macro tail for risk assets.

Equities.title: Strong Earnings Power Dow to Another Record
Equities.reason: WSJ highlights an earnings-driven upswing in large-cap cyclical names (Dow record). This reinforces a constructive macro/earnings narrative that can underpin broad equity indices even as tech leadership cools.

Equities.title: JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon warns of high leverage: 'Somebody will disrupt the market'
Equities.summary: JPMorgan Chief Executive Officer Jamie Dimon warned that leverage across financial markets remains elevated, adding that investors should be mindful that hidden borrowing could amplify market disruptions.
Equities.reason: A high‑profile caution about elevated leverage is a systemic risk reminder that could restrain risk appetite and make equity rallies more vulnerable to shocks—negative for market sentiment.

Rates.title: Fed Governor Cook says she's 'prepared to act' on rate hike to address inflation
Rates.summary: Cook was part of a 9-3 majority that voted last week to keep the central bank's benchmark borrowing rate in a range between 3.5%-3.75%.
Rates.reason: Hawkish Fed official signalling readiness to hike raises odds of higher-for-longer U.S. policy — negative for bond prices / upward pressure on yields.

Rates.title: Fed's Schmid calls for tighter monetary policy to tamp down on 'too high' inflation
Rates.reason: Another Fed voice pushing for tighter policy — reinforces a hawkish Fed narrative that supports higher nominal yields.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: Official FOMC communication is high-impact for rates; in the current context of Fed officials signalling caution/hawkishness, the statement supports a higher-for-longer yields backdrop.

Rates.title: Bank Rate maintained at 3.75% - July 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: BoE held Bank Rate at 3.75% — a policy hold amid sticky inflation dynamics implies limited near-term easing and modest upward pressure on UK yields.

Rates.title: ECB wage tracker at 2.7% in Q1 2027, indicating stable negotiated wage pressures
Rates.reason: Measured but persistent wage growth points to remaining inflationary pressure in the euro area — bearish for euro-area bonds (upward pressure on yields).

Rates.title: (BOJ Review) Impact of the Bank of Japan's Reductions in JGB Purchases on the JGB Markets
Rates.reason: BOJ research indicating reductions in JGB purchases signals less central bank demand — structurally negative for JGB prices and supportive of higher Japanese yields.

Rates.title: Statement on Monetary Policy
Rates.reason: BOJ policy statement is key to JGB market direction; ongoing adjustments away from large-scale purchases support a higher-JGB-yield narrative.

Rates.title: Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds (Competitive Auction Method) (July-September 2026) (Schedule Updates)
Rates.reason: Updated JGB purchase schedule (reduced/altered purchases) implies less BOJ support for the curve — negative for bond prices / upward pressure on yields.

Rates.title: Japan 30-Year Bond Sale Brings Relief Amid Fiscal Concerns
Rates.reason: Stronger-than-expected demand at a long JGB auction provides near-term relief for the bond market, offsetting some of the selloff pressure from policy-driven reductions in BOJ purchases.

Rates.title: Australian Dollar: RBA uneasy pause – Standard Chartered
Rates.summary: Standard Chartered’s Nicholas Chia expects the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) to keep the cash rate at 4.35% at its 11 August meeting, with no further hikes this year. Q2 core inflation and short-term expectations have eased, while the labour market has softe
Rates.reason: RBA expected to pause — limited easing/near-term stability suggests a mild relief for Australian bond yields (small positive for bond prices).

Rates.title: Brazilian Real: Cautious BCB easing offers limited support – Societe Generale
Rates.summary: Societe Generale’s Dev Ashish notes that the central bank of the Brazil, Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) cut the Selic rate by 25bp to 14.0% as expected, extending a 100bp easing cycle since March.
Rates.reason: BCB easing by 25bp is supportive for Brazilian bond prices (yields down) and indicates local easing momentum; relevant but region-specific for global rates.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index rebounds following Israeli airstrikes, Jobless Claims eyed
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is holding gains after two days of losses and trading around 99.80 during the European session on Thursday.
FX.reason: DXY rebound is a clear USD-strength signal (negative for non-USD FX). Geopolitical risk (Israeli airstrikes) and US data focus are market-wide drivers for currency flows, so this is a moderately high-relevance USD-strength item.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Policy shifts weigh on JPY against US Dollar – Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank's Senior Macro Strategist Bas van Geffen discusses renewed Japanese Yen (JPY) weakness following recent joint US-Japan FX intervention that briefly pushed USD/JPY below 156.
FX.reason: Direct JPY analysis citing policy shifts and recent coordinated intervention. JPY weakness reinforces USD strength narrative versus major FX; high relevance given intervention backdrop and policy signal.

FX.title: Yen struggles to hold intervention gains and drifts towards 158.00
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) is ticking lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, trimming gains after an exceptional US-Japan coordinated intervention triggered a 4.5% appreciation late last week.
FX.reason: Reports that intervention-driven JPY gains are fading point to renewed USD strength. This reinforces a major FX regime theme (intervention does not fully reverse trend), giving it above-average relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar receives support from higher oil prices
FX.summary: USD/CAD loses ground for the second successive day, trading around 1.4010 during the European hours on Thursday.
FX.reason: Oil-driven CAD strength (USD/CAD lower) is a clear FX-native commodity-to-currency transmission. Relevance is meaningful regionally and for commodity-linked FX flows, supporting a modest USD-weakness read.

FX.title: US Dollar: Wait-and-see mood before payrolls – ING
FX.summary: ING’s FX Strategist Francesco Pesole notes improved Gulf-related risk sentiment has weighed slightly on the Dollar, but stable Federal Reserve rate expectations remain supportive.
FX.reason: Fed rate expectations provide ongoing USD support even as geopolitical risk eases. This is a near-term USD-positive signal (negative direction) with standard relevance ahead of payrolls.

FX.title: US Dollar: Relief rallies seen shallow – BBH
FX.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s Elias Haddad notes that the US Dollar (USD) has recovered part of its recent losses as concerns over the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) credibility ease, but sees limited scope for a sustained rebound.
FX.reason: Notes a partial USD rebound but limited durability. It tempers the USD-strength narrative (smaller negative direction) and is of moderate relevance as a tactical view on follow-through.

FX.title: Indian Rupee ticks down, awaiting clarity on Hormuz deal
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday. The USD/INR pair rises to near 95.22 after rebounding from the fresh monthly low of 94.83 posted the previous day.
FX.reason: USD/INR uptick tied to regional geopolitics (Hormuz) and oil — a country-specific USD-strength move with limited cross-market transmission, so lower relevance.

FX.title: Korean Won Rises to Highest Since October on Exporters Dollar Sales
FX.reason: KRW strength driven by exporter dollar sales implies local USD demand easing — a dollar-weakness signal with decent FX-market relevance given EM/Asia flow implications.

FX.title: Eurozone Retail Sales declines unexpectedly by 0.3% MoM in June
FX.summary: Eurozone Retail Sales contracted at a 0.3% pace Month-on-Month (MoM) in June, while they were anticipated to have risen moderately by 0.1%, from 0.4% in May, revised higher from 0.2%.
FX.reason: Soft eurozone retail sales are a direct negative data impulse for the euro (implying relative USD strength). It's macro-relevant for EURUSD positioning, hence moderate relevance.

FX.title: Bank of America Sees Yen Jumping 6% by End of 2026
FX.reason: Analyst forecast for sizeable yen appreciation is a notable counter-narrative to near-term JPY weakness. As a forward-looking institutional call it carries some relevance but lower immediacy than intervention/news-driven items.

Commodities.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD bulls target $4,380 buoyed by lower US yields
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) consolidates gains after appreciating nearly $200 this week, buoyed by lower US Treasury yields as traders dial down bets of immediate Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hikes.
Commodities.reason: Gold bid on lower US Treasury yields and reduced Fed hike bets — a clear bullish commodity narrative (safe-haven + yield-driven demand). High relevance given large recent move and macro drivers.

Commodities.title: Gold: Breakout extends as yields ease – OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC’s Christopher Wong and Sim Moh Siong highlight a sharp rebound in Gold as easing Middle East tensions weighed on Oil and US Treasury yields, softening the US Dollar.
Commodities.reason: Confirms broader gold breakout narrative: easing geopolitical risk -> lower oil/yields -> softer USD, supporting higher gold prices. Market-confirming commentary (moderately high relevance).

Commodities.title: Gold: Hormuz optimism supports rally – ING
Commodities.summary: ING’s Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey highlight a sharp Gold rally of more than 4%, with prices moving closer to $4,300/oz as optimism grows that a US-Iran agreement and lower energy prices will ease inflation.
Commodities.reason: Links Hormuz optimism and falling energy-driven inflation expectations to stronger gold — reinforces the prevailing cross-commodity/geopolitical-driven gold rally narrative.

Commodities.title: Gold steadies near seven-week high as markets await Strait of Hormuz deal
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) consolidates its recent gains on Thursday after briefly climbing above $4,300 as the US Dollar (USD) steadies while traders await confirmation of a possible Iran-Oman agreement on the Strait of Hormuz. At the time of writing, XAU/USD trades arou
Commodities.reason: Intraday consolidation at multi-week highs while markets price a Hormuz deal — supports ongoing bullish momentum for gold tied to geopolitical developments and USD/yield moves.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD clings to gains near $62 with US NFP in focus
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) holds onto two-day gains at around $62.00 during the European trading session on Thursday. The white metal trades firmly amid hopes of a further decline in oil prices.
Commodities.reason: Silver holding gains alongside gold amid hopes of falling oil — modest positive; relevance limited (short-term/price-forecast focus).

Commodities.title: China's crude oil imports fell in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: China, the world's largest importer of crude oil, imported less crude oil in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) following higher crude oil prices that resulted from disrupted flows through the Strait of Hormuz. China's lower imports reduced global demand, softe
Commodities.reason: Lower Chinese crude imports reduce physical demand — a meaningful bearish fundamental for oil supply/demand and global balances in Q2; medium-high relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil Holds Three-Day Drop as Iran, Oman Reach Hormuz Agreement
Commodities.reason: Market-moving Reuters/Bloomberg-style headline: Hormuz diplomatic progress removes a large geopolitical risk premium, prompting a notable multi-day oil price drop. High relevance to crude.

Commodities.title: Iran says it has reached agreement with Oman on Hormuz shipping route
Commodities.summary: Islamic republic is determined to retain a degree of control over the chokepoint
Commodities.reason: FT reports on a Hormuz agreement — a substantive geopolitical development that lowers oil risk-premium and flows into weaker oil prices; significant for energy markets.

Commodities.title: Ukraine’s military hits one of Russia’s biggest oil refineries in long-range drone attack
Commodities.summary: The Slavneft-Yanos facility in Yaroslavl, which is situated hundreds of miles from the Ukraine border, is one of Russia's biggest oil refineries.
Commodities.reason: Attack on a large Russian refinery is a potential supply disruption, supporting near-term oil prices. Counterbalances Hormuz-driven downside; medium-high relevance.

Commodities.title: Lower crude oil prices reduced U.S.-Canada energy trade value in 2025
Commodities.summary: The value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau. Energy trade value is the total value of energy imports and exports between two countries and is dri
Commodities.reason: Lower crude prices reduced cross-border energy trade value — secondary confirmation of weaker oil price environment; modest relevance (trade-value focus rather than physical balances).

Commodities.title: The U.S.-Canada natural gas and electricity trade value rose in 2025
Commodities.summary: Although the total value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau, the trade value of natural gas and electricity between the two countries increased sl
Commodities.reason: Increase in natural gas trade value points to firmer cross-border gas flows/demand — small positive signal for natural gas fundamentals; relevance limited by focus on trade-value rather than price shocks.

Crypto.title: Coldcard hack sparks a self-custody security overhaul: Cory Klippsten
Crypto.reason: Large hardware-wallet exploit undermines trust in self-custody, likely shifting flows toward custodial/regulated bitcoin products and reducing risk appetite for non-custodial holdings.

Crypto.title: Coldcard exploit could boost demand for regulated bitcoin exposure, analysts say
Crypto.reason: Analyst view that a major self-custody breach will drive investor demand into regulated/ custodied bitcoin products — positive for institutional/regulatory crypto product flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin developers flag 85 critical bugs in an "extremely bad" situation
Crypto.reason: Large number of critical protocol bugs raises systemic risk and short-term confidence concerns for Bitcoin, increasing sell-side risk and potential liquidity premia.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Coinbase lets UK users trade U.S. equities. BTC trades near $65,000
Crypto.reason: Coinbase product expansion into UK equities increases platform utility and institutional engagement; accompanied by BTC strength near $65k — modest positive for adoption/flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin steadies above $64,000 as traders watch $100 billion SpaceX unlock
Crypto.reason: Price stability around elevated levels reflects ongoing macro/wealth-driven flows; potential large equity unlock (SpaceX) is a watch item for liquidity impacts on crypto but is not clearly directional yet.

Crypto.title: Yellow Card raises $40 million to link banks to stablecoin processing
Crypto.reason: Funding to connect banks with stablecoin rails strengthens fiat-crypto on/off ramps and institutional plumbing, a clear positive for broader crypto liquidity and adoption.

Crypto.title: NFT startup founder charged with misusing funds from $10 million fundraising
Crypto.reason: Founder criminal charges reinforce legal/operational risks in the NFT/startup space; negative for trust and investor sentiment in niche tokenized-assets but limited systemic impact.

Crypto.title: AI agent token once worth $2.4 billion ends with founder calling it dead
Crypto.reason: Collapse of a large AI-themed token signals fading speculative hype in AI crypto projects and could curb speculative flows into similar meme/AI tokens.

Crypto.title: XRP whales keep buying the dip, but ether shows deeper capitulation
Crypto.reason: Divergent altcoin flows: accumulation into XRP but notable ETH capitulation suggests uneven risk appetite across major crypto assets, a modest net negative for broader altcoin market sentiment.
